rubric_items.reason: All 9 design components have at least one threat (T-1 to T-11). This includes the existing dashboardRouter, Tile and appointment list, plus both tests.
Most threats fit their component: a crafted period, a link built from free text, real data in tests, and access to reachable routes. T-6 and T-8 are thin restatements with little real risk.

Each mitigation cites code (PERIODS, bound parameters, toSummary fields, Tile) or names a new control for implement. T-1/T-4 now correctly scope the claim to the new count and name the unchanged `next` list.
The only real gap, network exposure before release, is marked assumed for T-5, recorded as U-1 and asked in Q-01 with options and a default. T-9 is now known, based on code that can be checked.
Threats are ordered by risk, with T-5 and T-9 first, as stated. Claim ids are now only the artifact's own C1-C19, so citations are not ambiguous.
